Jenna (Partnerships): Quick checkpoint for Friday launch prep. Final ask list: partner logos, quote, marketplace SKU, demo tenant, and PR embargo confirmation. Who has final ownership?
Arun (Marketing): I'll own PR + marketplace copy. Partners requested 07:00 PT embargo instead of 08:00. Is that feasible? Need logos by Thu 18:00 PT.
Wei (Platform): SKU created: marketplace-lite-2026. Demo tenant provisioning in progress, keys ETA 60m. Earlier embargo ok from our side if design + legal are green.
Hannah (Design): Can do hero update for 07:00 ship, but need SVG logos and a 120x40 badge by Thu 17:30.
LegalBot: Reminder: logos require signed trademark form. If we receive forms by Thu 16:30 we can sign off before embargo.
Jenna (Partnerships): I'll chase partners for logos and signed forms now. Arun, set embargo 07:00 then; Wei please post sandbox endpoint when ready. Everyone ack?
Arun (Marketing): ack :thumbsup:
Wei (Platform): ack — posting keys in #secure-ops when ready.
Hannah (Design): ack
LegalBot: ack
Jenna (Partnerships): Thanks team — I'll update the Asana checklist and send the final runbook for the 06:30 preflight.
